atomic_cutover: One code-only change. Calendar dates come from sharedkernel/calendar instead of the internal/timezone wrapper. The retained People Directory, Care Plan and Enrollment values the workflow hands back unchanged are named through the workflow port (workflows/parentportal vocabulary), declared once in the care and messaging flow packages that return them; the enrollment profile port returns the HTTP values the response renders and the root translates People Directory's loader result (api/enrollment_route_ports.go). The locale check calls Delivery's notifications.IsSupportedLocale. The enrollment routes open their tenant and administrative transactions through tenant.WithinTenant and tenant.WithinAdmin, so the resource and its config lose the *bun.DB. The handler suites take setting keys from modules/settings, double the workflow settings through the port's SettingsService name, compose through api/testutil re-exports instead of services, replace retained model constants by owner contracts (schoolcalendar/portal, appointments, careplan/carerequests) and rely on the fixture package's pinned JWT configuration instead of writing viper. ADR 0051 grants the three standing HTTP runtimes (api/common, the session adapter, the tenant runtime) and the session adapter for the suites as four rules in epoch 39, gated by reviewedParentHTTPRule; no temporary rule, ownership or classification change.
